summary_for_children: Al-Mulk means The Dominion. It invites us to look at the sky again and again and find no flaw, to see the birds held up by Allah, and to walk the earth He made easy for us.
world_title: Seven Skies and the Outspread Wings
environment_concept: A sky without flaw to look at again and again (67:3-4), slopes to walk (67:15) and birds with outspread wings (67:19).
architecture_and_scenery: Seven layered skies, wide slopes, flocks of birds.

palette.lighting: Clear sky with stars at dusk

areas.name: Stars
areas.description: The nearest sky adorned with stars.

activities.name: Find a flaw
activities.description: Look twice at the sky; find none.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Bird watch
activities.description: Find five birds resting on the ground.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Walk the slopes
activities.description: Lay five numbered stones up the slope.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (birds, horizon, mountain, steps) with 2 hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
